name: dat
description: Pick the simplest sufficient agent team structure (P0/T0/T1/T2/T3) before a task, and record what actually ran as a RunObservation after it. Runtime-agnostic specification plus two skills; it never applies runtime configuration.

interface.shortDescription: Choose the simplest sufficient agent team structure and record what actually ran
interface.longDescription: DAT is a runtime-agnostic specification for choosing and observing AI agent team structures. dat-select picks the simplest sufficient topology (P0/T0/T1/T2/T3) with reasons before a task; dat-observe records a RunObservation after it and summarizes stored records. It does not apply runtime configuration.
